# Vela

> Vela is a framework (Vela.Plugins, .NET Framework 4.6.2, for plug-ins on 4.6.2 through 4.8), a CLI (Vela.Cli, command `vela`) and an in-memory test harness (Vela.Testing) for Microsoft Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs, with a preview-first `vela plan` then `vela apply` workflow. Steps are declared in code with a type-state fluent builder; Roslyn analyzers (VELA001-VELA028) reject invalid registrations at build time.

Key facts: plugin classes are `sealed partial` with a primary constructor `(string unsecureConfig, string secureConfig)`; Create/Update steps require `FilterOn(...)`; the handler context exposes `ctx.Service`, `ctx.SystemService` and `ctx.AsUser(id)`; `vela plan` and `vela apply` require `--solution <uniquename>` (one solution per run) and `vela add customapi` requires `--prefix <publisherprefix>`; `vela plan --json` and `vela help --json` are machine-readable. A project scaffolded by `vela init` has its own AGENTS.md, and a PROJECT.md that records those values (the CLI never reads it: pass them as flags).

## Getting started

- [Install](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/install.md): install the vela CLI and the prerequisites (.NET 10 SDK, Mono for .NET Framework tests outside Windows, an existing solution)
- [Quickstart](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/quickstart.md): from an empty folder to deployed steps: init, build, plan, apply
- [Initialize a solution](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/getting-started/initialize-a-solution.md): what vela init scaffolds and where to edit

## Write plugins and Custom APIs

- [Write a plugin](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/plugins.md): the step builder: typed triggers, stages, modes, FilterOn, images, several steps per trigger, typed handler contexts
- [Write a Custom API](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/custom-apis.md): typed request/response, parameters (required by default), binding, the rules Build() enforces
- [Typed queries](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/queries.md): typed QueryExpression and FetchXML helpers
- [Dependency injection](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/dependency-injection.md): the sandbox-safe container and the default services
- [Caching](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/caching.md): TTL cache scoped per organization
- [Environment variables](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/environment-variables.md): read Dataverse environment variables, typed
- [Localized messages](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/localization.md): resolve messages in the user's or the organization's language
- [Managed identity](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/managed-identity.md): call external APIs with a managed-identity token
- [Telemetry](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/telemetry.md): trace log and Application Insights through the platform logger
- [Escape hatches](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/escape-hatches.md): drop to the raw Dataverse SDK
- [Early-bound models](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/models.md): vela models: entities, Custom API and SDK messages, roles

## Test

- [Testing](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/testing.md): PluginContext for one plugin, PluginPipeline for the whole in-memory pipeline
- [Security model in tests](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/security-model.md): roles, privileges, business units, teams, sharing

## CLI and deployment

- [The vela CLI](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/cli-overview.md): commands, generated help, exit codes
- [Plan and apply](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/plan-apply.md): preview then apply registrations; --solution, secure config, CI usage
- [vela add](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/add.md): generate a plugin, service, Custom API, test or step
- [vela init](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/scaffold.md): scaffold a solution
- [Signing](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/signing.md): sign a plugin package for managed identity
- [Client-side (preview)](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/client-side.md): TypeScript form scripts and web resources, work in progress
- [Authentication](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/configuration/authentication.md): interactive, ambient Azure credential, client secret, connection string
- [Environments and CI](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/configuration/environments-secrets.md): environment URLs, secrets and pipelines

## Reference

- [Machine-readable output](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/reference/machine-readable-output.md): the versioned JSON contract of plan, apply and inspect, and the exit codes
- [CLI cheat sheet](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/reference/cli-cheatsheet.md): every command and environment variable at a glance
- [Analyzers and generators](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/reference/analyzers.md): VELA001 to VELA028, their code fixes, and the source generator
- [Limitations](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/reference/limitations.md): what is out of scope, and where the harness differs from Dataverse
- [FAQ](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/reference/faq.md): common questions
- [Troubleshooting](https://allandecastro.github.io/vela/guides/troubleshooting.md): fixes for common errors
